label: Birds daily email
info:
End-of-day bird table for the daily email.

Flow A (top) is recommended: it asks the BirdNET API for the last 24h at
midnight and gets exact per-species counts from the database, with no
state to lose.

Flow B (bottom) tracks the MQTT stream instead. The bridge polls with
hours=24, so each message already carries a daily count and Flow B keeps
the latest per species. Two caveats: that count is a rolling 24h window
anchored at the species' last sighting rather than the calendar day, so a
bird last heard early reaches back into the previous day; and the tally is
lost if Node-RED restarts mid-day without persistent context.

Enable ONE of them, or both will append two tables to the same file.
